description: Moderate the connected X account's live broadcast chat. action 'remove_message' (broadcastId + messageId; cannot be undone, confirm:true), 'mute' (broadcastId + userId or username; until = when a timeout ends, omit to mute indefinitely; messageId removes that message while muting), 'unmute', 'list_mutes' (everyone muted across the brand's chats), 'mute_everywhere' / 'unmute_everywhere' (userId or username, every chat of the brand; when the brand moderates another host, broadcastId scopes it to that host), and the account's PERSISTENT chat moderators, which apply to every current and future broadcast: 'list_moderators', 'add_moderator', 'remove_moderator' (userId or username). Only the host or a moderator can moderate, and X says so if not. A username costs one extra lookup. Needs X connected with the broadcast permissions added 2026-09-21: an X connection made before then must be reconnected once under Settings > Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

action.description: remove_message, mute, unmute, list_moderators, add_moderator, remove_moderator, list_mutes, mute_everywhere or unmute_everywhere

broadcastId.description: broadcast id; for remove_message, mute and unmute

messageId.description: chat message id to remove; with mute, also removes that message

until.description: mute end, ISO 8601 or epoch ms

username.description: X handle, resolved to the id for you

name: moderate_x_broadcast
title: Moderate an X broadcast chat
